scope: Canonical state graph controls, undo/redo, native persistence, reference navigation, diagnostics, priority order, template Behavior duplication and emitted 6502 input transition. Mock DOM evidence; browser and physical-device checks remain separate.

results.name: Graph is reachable within Gameplay Core and selections never mutate canonical source or history
Actual graph controls add a state and typed transition into the existing canonical tables, with single-edit undo and redo
The graph refreshes when table authoring and project Undo change the same source
Invalid transition edits are rejected atomically; connected and initial states cannot be silently removed
Deleting a transition then an unreferenced state is explicit and undo restores their exact records
Ordered action controls edit typed operands, reorder the actual table, and preserve precise compiler diagnostics
Priority ties use actual transition table order and diagnostics identify unconditional shadowing
Structural reachability is a warning with exact navigable source, and graph references navigate endpoints
Duplicating a template Behavior changes only the selected Actor Definition and is one undoable canonical edit
Player compatibility and disabled Behavior are explicitly diagnosed instead of promising graph execution
Graph-created canonical data survives native project save and reload with byte-identical ROM output
A graph-authored input transition executes in the emitted 6502 runtime
